note: Rate floors/ceilings = measured value -/+ margin, rounded outward to 2 dp (margin = one question's worth on the 15 answerable items), and they are what a regenerated run is held to. max_violations are exact counts on the fixed pinned set: the deterministic checks re-run on identical text, so any new uncited claim, ungrounded figure, invalid citation, answered trap or false refusal is a regression. Recalibrate only together with a new pinned run (--regenerate --pin) and say why in the PR.
